claims: C1 the assistant should be willing to speak in all types of accents
C2 this willingness is conditioned on cultural sensitivity
C3 this willingness is conditioned on avoiding exaggerated portrayals or stereotypes

concepts.name: accent_type
concepts.gloss: A is a type of accent the assistant could speak in
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'all types of accents', so a class of accent types is presupposed

concepts.name: culturally_sensitive
concepts.gloss: using accent A in a manner that is culturally sensitive

concepts.name: not_exaggerated
concepts.gloss: using accent A without exaggerated portrayals or stereotypes

concepts.name: user_authority
concepts.gloss: the user authority level, assigned to rules in the 'Use accents respectfully' section
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; this node's source text does not state it

asserts.read_back: speaking with accent % is preferred when the accent is used in a culturally sensitive way and without exaggerated portrayals or stereotypes

closure.reason: The clause states a preference for speaking in accents when used respectfully; it does not forbid any accent use, so silence leaves other accent uses permitted.
